data.one_liner: Floating chathead overlays for Android and iOS with draggable bubbles and custom widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides floating, draggable chathead bubbles that appear on top of your app (or other apps on Android) and expand into any custom Flutter widget. It handles platform permissions, spring-physics edge snapping, and bidirectional messaging between the main app and the overlay.
use_when: You want to build Facebook Messenger-style chat bubbles or floating mini-players.
You need an overlay panel that runs in a separate engine and survives app closure on Android.
avoid_when: You only need standard in-app overlays or dialogs that don't require system-wide floating windows.
You want to support platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Unified cross-platform API for Android and iOS
Supports any arbitrary Flutter widget inside the expanded panel
Built-in spring physics for edge snapping and draggable motions
Bidirectional communication streams between main app and overlay
weaknesses: Requires system-level alert window permissions on Android
Android foreground service requires a Google Play special use declaration
data.setup_notes: Native permissions and service configurations are bundled by the plugin automatically; Google Play requires a special use declaration for the foreground service.
